bio: Francesco Maria Moraca was baptized on 22 July 1793 at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, the son of Angelo Moraca and Rosanna Marasco. He married Francesca Orlando on 16 March 1819 at San Mango d'Aquino. He died there on 23 February 1837, aged about 43, though the death record gave his age as 40. He is John's 4th-great-grandfather.
